reader_summary.headline: Bobby Jain is the CEO and CIO of Jain Global.
reader_summary.overview: Bobby Jain is the CEO and CIO of Jain Global. Bobby's storied Wall Street career includes spending seven years as the Co-CIO of Millenium and twenty at Credit Suisse in a range of leadership roles spanning proprietary trading. Our conversation traces Bobby's path from growing up as the son of immigrants in Queens to the trading floors of O'Connor and Credit Suisse.
